gates.name: Mission 1 native project build
work: Run exactly one bundled-dotnet UnrealBuildTool build in a fresh namespace
Preserve compiler, linker, process, timeout, and numeric exit-code evidence
Verify the static root-mobility correction compiles
Run focused environment unit and integration tests
Freeze the accepted build or terminal failure
acceptance: No timeout or second build launch
Required current binaries and receipts exist and hash correctly

gates.name: Recovery05 native proof plugin
work: Build unique Recovery05 plugin/module identity
Keep plugin disabled by default
Preserve Recovery04 behavioral parity except authorized corrections
Disable TCP and UDP messaging
Retain tick-driven shader readiness, warmup, metrics, restoration, terminal receipts, no world save

gates.name: Recovery05 runtime binding
work: Bind exact accepted plugin binary, production map, material, cameras, metrics, rubrics, and fresh namespaces
Verify plugin enable/disable arguments and messaging isolation
Freeze timeout, restoration, process, and evidence protocols
Produce a one-shot Unreal supervisor without launching it

gates.name: Representative Mission 1 Unreal visual proof
work: Run one UE 5.8 D3D12 SM6 proof
Require stable readiness, 30-second warmup, 30-second measurement, and at least 900 samples
Capture five static and three temporal 2560x1440 originals
Independently verify material restoration and no world save
Inspect all captures at full resolution

gates.name: Yak-52 R6 production asset
work: Complete verified dimensions and orthographic/sectional reference intake
Correct fuselage, wing root, cowling, propeller, tail, gear, canopy, cockpit, pilot and rear-gunner arrangement
Build production topology, UVs, bake sources, PBR materials, pivots, collision, sockets, hierarchy, and damage states
Produce ten unobstructed validation renders
Pass dimensional and direct visual review before Unreal import

gates.name: Player, weapons, drones, bosses, and combat art
work: Production pilot and rear-gunner bodies, anatomically convincing arms and leather gloves
Production rifle, iron sights, ADS, recoil, reload, and airframe-safe firing arcs
Production Igla, lock feedback, correct missile orientation, launch, tracking, impact, and reload
Production Shahed/heavy drones, ten bosses, weak points, damage states, debris, fire, smoke, sparks, and explosions
Pool and prewarm destruction/audio to eliminate multi-second stalls
Measure ADS plus fire, drone breakup, missile impact, and boss destruction

gates.name: Mission 1 mapped environment and vertical slice
work: Replace proxy/diagnostic geometry with grounded production environment
Complete ocean, waterline, beach, dunes, terrain, city, roads, promenade, vegetation, traffic, lighthouse, radar, atmosphere and boss encounter
Use licensed Fab/Quixel support assets, Blender hero assets, and Unreal assembly/PCG/Nanite/Lumen/Niagara/audio
Pass visual, traversal, combat, input, audio, performance, and stability gates

gates.name: Mission 1 integration and packaged validation
work: Create fresh Development package
Validate briefing/warmup, input, ADS/fire, Igla, protection arcs, destruction, boss phases, success/failure, pause/settings, save/progression, audio, memory, VRAM, restarts and soak
Run three 1080p input-driven combat captures and one 20-minute combat soak

gates.name: Ten-mission campaign production
acceptance: Unique route, briefing, objective structure, skyline, weather, pacing, threats, hero assets, boss phases, destruction and aftermath per mission
Approximately 65-70% modular geometry reuse without duplicated layouts
Per-mission packaged visual, input, combat, audio, performance, and stability evidence

gates.name: Presentation, sound, and player experience
work: Mission briefings, radio chatter, pictograms, flight cards, military aviation UI
Physical iron sights and diegetic Igla lock feedback
Realistic spatial engine, propeller, wind, canopy, rifle, missile, impact, explosion, debris, radio, city, ocean and weather audio
Subtitles, sliders, presets, key rebinding, sensitivity, ADS settings, accessibility, save, unlocks, scoring, debriefing, tutorial

gates.name: Optimization and final release candidate
work: Freeze scalability and supported-hardware matrix
Eliminate destruction and ADS/fire stalls
Validate HLOD, Nanite, streaming, PCG, Niagara, audio, AI, shader warmup, memory, VRAM and transitions
Run extended soaks, repeated restarts and full campaign regression
Build Development and Shipping release candidates
Validate clean-machine install, launch, progression, shutdown, crash recovery and uninstall
Close all provenance, privacy, configuration and release-documentation gaps
